name: Schrödinger’s wave eigenvalue formulation
description: Quantization as a wave eigenvalue problem for hydrogen.

impact.note: A workable wave equation for physicists and chemists; quantum chemistry, solid-state physics and the technologies built on them stand on it.

date.basis: Year of the historical document; work may have begun earlier.

events.statement: The first 1926 paper replaced a quantization prescription with an eigenvalue problem and applied it to the nonrelativistic unperturbed hydrogen atom.
